description: This file defines an immutable class representing a JSON boolean value within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static instances for true and false, methods for creating instances, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonBoolean
classes.description: An immutable class encapsulating a JSON boolean value, with static instances for true/false, and methods for serialization and value retrieval.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonBoolean instance for a given boolean value.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a boolean.
